title: Treasure Hunt
hook: 爷爷奶奶在花园里藏了宝藏，画了一张海盗藏宝图，让佩奇和乔治顺着线索去找。

cells.q: What are Granny and Grandpa Pig making?
cells.a: They are making a treasure hunt for Peppa and George.
cells.cn: 他们在给佩奇和乔治准备一场寻宝游戏。

cells.q: What did Granny Pig call out?
cells.a: She called, “Quick, Grandpa Pig! They're here!”
cells.cn: 她喊：“快，猪爷爷！他们来了！”

cells.a: Granny says it is buried somewhere in the garden.
cells.cn: 奶奶说宝藏就埋在花园里的某个地方。

cells.q: Was the treasure map easy to read?
cells.a: No, they say the map is a bit difficult.
cells.cn: 不，他们说这张图有点难认。

cells.q: What did Peppa find, and what did she ask?
cells.a: She found the first clue and asked where the bottle was.
cells.cn: 她找到了第一个线索，还问瓶子在哪里。

cells.q: Why couldn't Mummy read the pirate's message?
cells.a: She said this pirate has very bad handwriting.
cells.cn: 她说这个海盗的字写得很糟。

cells.q: What are Peppa and George doing now?
cells.a: They are following the arrows to the next clue.
cells.cn: 他们顺着箭头去找下一个线索。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig call out?
cells.a: He called, “Hang on! There is something here!”
cells.cn: 他喊：“等一下！这里有东西！”

cells.q: What was inside the treasure chest?
cells.a: Chocolate coins! Peppa and George love chocolate coins.
cells.cn: 巧克力金币！佩奇和乔治最喜欢了。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: treasure, map, clue, pirate, arrow, chocolate
helper.actions: make, draw, look for, follow, find, open

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Treasure Hunt”.
ending: In the end, the treasure is chocolate coins. My favourite part is ______.
